messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable browser game from the user's brief "2D Diablo loot in a Vampire Survivors run".

## Requirements
- Combine Vampire Survivors-style auto-battling survivor runs with Diablo-style 2D loot: rarities, affixes, equipment slots, loot beams, power comparisons.
- Deliver a polished, visually strong, responsive browser game; verify in a real browser with screenshots.
- User did not specify additional constraints.

## Decisions
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS static site, no build step/dependencies, canvas 2D with procedurally generated art/audio (no external assets).
- Name: **GRAVEBOUND** — "The dead are endless. The loot is not."
- Game design: 6 gear slots (weapon/helm/armor/boots/amulet/ring), 5 rarities (common, magic, rare, legendary, mythic), 8 legendary powers, 24-slot satchel, auto-pickup gear beams, inventory with power comparisons and devour-for-XP.
- Run structure: 4-minute timer until boss **The Blood Count**, victory on boss kill; elites, treasure fiends, XP gems, level-up boon cards, 11 upgrades, boss bar, death/victory screens.
- Responsive with touch joystick, mobile-safe layout, WebAudio synth sounds, mute persistence.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html`, `styles.css`, `src/rng.js`, `src/loot.js`, `src/audio.js`, `src/sprites.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/renderer.js`, `src/ui.js`, `src/main.js` created.
- Core game loop, horde spawning, elites, boss, weapons/upgrades, loot generation/pickup, inventory, HUD, title/level-up/pause/end overlays implemented.
- Tutorial/title screen and gameplay render successfully in Chromium; no JS errors after fixes.
- Replaced visible tiled-ground seams with one seamless `buildWorldGround` texture and reduced darkness.
- Static server runs on `http://localhost:3002` in tmux session `gravebound` using `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- Playwright Chromium installed via `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`; Xvfb/headed setup working.
- Latest spawned-combat test succeeded: 47 enemies, 5 loot drops, state `playing`; screenshot `screenshots/combat-01.png` was captured but not yet inspected.

### Active
- Visual QA of combat + loot screenshot; ground cobblestone patches were just toned down but not re-verified.
- Need to verify inventory UI, level-up overlay, boss/victory flow, and mobile layout.
- Need tests (`test/loot.test.mjs`), README rewrite, favicon (currently 404), and final polish/screenshots.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/combat-01.png`; judge enemy/loot readability and ground patches.
2. Reload, start run, spawn loot/elite again if needed; capture combat, inventory (press `I`), level-up (trigger XP/level), and boss screenshots.
3. Fix visual/UI issues found (player readability, beam labels, HUD overlap, objective wrapping, inventory layout).
4. Test boss flow by setting `game.run.time = 240` / spawning boss and verify victory + forced loot pickup.
5. Test mobile viewport/touch layout via `playwright-cli resize 390 844` and screenshot.
6. Add loot unit tests, update README, add favicon, run final syntax checks and screenshots.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game.js`: run logic, spawning, combat, loot pickup, upgrades, boss, state flow.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/renderer.js`: canvas rendering, ground crop, lighting, loot beams, sprites, effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/sprites.js`: procedural player/enemy/props/ground/item-icon art.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/loot.js`: rarities, affixes, score, legendary powers, item generation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: HUD, level-up cards, inventory detail/tooltips, banners, end screens.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: gothic UI, responsive breakpoints, inventory/paper doll layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM structure and SVG icon sprite.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: synthesized SFX/ambient.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: boot, rAF loop, `window.__gravebound = { game, ui }`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: title/game/combat captures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: still original OMGithub template; needs project docs.

## Important Context
- No `package.json` may be added: runtime's `default-start.mjs` rejects non-Vite package projects. Node tests must copy `src` to a temp dir with `{"type":"module"}` package.json, or use another workaround; `--experimental-default-type=module` is NOT supported by Node v24.22.1.

# GRAVEBOUND

**The dead are endless. The loot is not.**

A playable browser game that fuses a **Vampire Survivors-style auto-battler run** with **Diablo-style 2D loot**. Carve through a rising horde, chase loot beams, and build a character out of whatever the graveyard bleeds.

![Gravebound combat](screenshots/combat-03.png)

## Play

No build step, no dependencies, no install. Serve the folder with any static file server and open it:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
# http://localhost:3002
```

Or use any equivalent static host.

## The run

- Survive **4 minutes** until **The Blood Count** awakens. Kill him to win.
- Attacks are automatic; you steer, dodge, and collect.
- Elites drop extra gear. **Treasure fiends** flee and burst into a hoard when killed.
- XP gems level you up and offer one of three **boons** (11 upgrade tracks).
- Death or victory ends the run with a summary of relics, legendaries, kills, and gear power.

## The loot

- **6 slots:** weapon, helm, chest, boots, amulet, ring.
- **5 rarities:** common, magic, rare, legendary, mythic, each with more affixes and higher power.
- **14 affixes** across offense, defense, movement, pickup, XP, luck, and area.
- **8 legendary powers**, including chaining soul bolts, loot gravity, harvesting low-health enemies, and orbiting bone blades.
- Every beam is auto-pulled when you walk over it. New gear is compared against what you wear, and anything useful goes to the **24-slot satchel**.
- Open the satchel to inspect affixes, compare power, equip upgrades, or **devour** spare relics for XP.

## Controls

| Action | Desktop | Touch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move | `WASD` / arrow keys | Drag the left side of the screen |
| Inventory | `I` / bag button | Bag button |
| Choose boon | `1` `2` `3` / click | Tap a card |
| Pause | `Esc` / pause button | Pause button |
| Mute | `M` / speaker button | Speaker button |

Sound is synthesized with WebAudio; the mute preference persists between sessions.

## Tech

- Vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript modules. No framework, no bundler, no image or audio assets.
- Canvas 2D renderer with procedurally painted ground, sprites, item icons, beams, fog, and lighting.
- Procedural WebAudio SFX and ambience.
- DOM overlays for the HUD, inventory, boon cards, pause, and end screens.
- Fully responsive, including a compact mobile inventory and touch joystick.

## Project layout

```
index.html            DOM shell, HUD, overlays, SVG icon sprite
styles.css            gothic UI, responsive layout, inventory paper doll
src/main.js           boot and animation loop
src/game.js           run state, combat, spawning, loot pickup, boss flow
src/renderer.js       canvas world, lighting, beams, sprites, effects
src/sprites.js        procedural ground, characters, props, item icons
src/loot.js           rarities, affixes, names, legendary powers, scoring
src/ui.js             HUD, boons, inventory, feed, banners, end screens
src/audio.js          synthesized music and sound effects
src/rng.js            seedable random helpers
test/run.mjs          Node tests for the loot system
```

## Tests

The source uses browser-native `.js` ES modules without a `package.json`, so the test runner stages the source in a temporary module directory:

```bash
node test/run.mjs
```

Covers deterministic generation, rarity/affix rules, legendary powers, luck scaling, item level scaling, naming, stat aggregation, scoring, and comparison helpers.
